sourceRegister.role: paper structure, section marks and component scope
assessment objectives, overall assessment constraints and scaling
currency bridge for pre-2025 assessment calibration
sourceRegister.fact: AQA states that the 2025 subject-content revision did not change assessment, question types or paper structure.

assessmentModel.placementImplication: Paper scope is academically real. Keep Course Truth nodes single-source; preserve paper identity for assessment and downstream Blueprint decisions rather than duplicating identical knowledge nodes.

papers.name: Issues and Options in Psychology
papers.attemptRule: Section A plus exactly one topic from each of Sections B, C and D.

AO1.summary: knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures

AO2.summary: application of knowledge and understanding in theoretical, practical, qualitative-data and quantitative-data contexts

AO3.summary: analysis, interpretation and evaluation, including judgement, conclusions and refinement of practical design/procedures

crossPaperConstraints.synopticExpectation: Assessment can require students to draw together knowledge and skills across the course; Paper 3 Issues and Debates supports cross-topic synthesis.

questionFamilies.name: Multiple choice
questionFamilies.responseShape: select one valid response from supplied alternatives
questionFamilies.tariffRule: variable low tariff; do not hard-code a future-paper count from historical papers
questionFamilies.generationRule: Distractors must test meaningful psychological distinctions, not wording tricks.

questionFamilies.name: Short answer
questionFamilies.responseShape: concise selected knowledge, explanation, application or evaluation
questionFamilies.tariffRule: variable; fewer marks than maximum extended writing
questionFamilies.generationRule: The stem must make the required scope and response demand clear enough for a fair Revision marking pack.

questionFamilies.name: Stem or scenario application
questionFamilies.responseShape: apply relevant psychological knowledge to supplied cues; may be mixed with AO1/AO3
questionFamilies.generationRule: The scenario must contain usable but non-leading cues and require selection/application rather than quotation.

questionFamilies.name: Extended writing
questionFamilies.responseShape: planned, coherent and developed reasoning responsive to the exact command
questionFamilies.generationRule: Do not require a fixed number of 16-mark questions. Use current section totals and AO constraints, then calibrate the mix without copying historical questions.

questionFamilies.name: Research methods and practical design
questionFamilies.responseShape: method selection, design/refinement, ethics, reliability/validity, practical reasoning or interpretation
questionFamilies.tariffRule: variable; can be standalone or embedded in topic/scenario questions
questionFamilies.generationRule: Require decisions to be justified against the supplied study context where application is intended.

questionFamilies.name: Data and mathematical handling
questionFamilies.responseShape: calculate, select, present, interpret or evaluate quantitative/qualitative evidence
questionFamilies.tariffRule: variable and may be embedded within research-method or topic questions
questionFamilies.generationRule: All numerical data must be internally consistent and independently recomputable.

commandDemandModel.rule: Question authors must map each command to the intended AO demand and response evidence; command words are not interchangeable decoration.

extendedResponse.qualityExpectation: sustained, coherent, relevant and substantiated reasoning with logical structure where the task requires extended response

revisionOwnedAssessmentRules: Official AQA sources remain REFERENCE_ONLY; downstream generation receives structured alignment facts, not copied protected question or mark-scheme prose.

All Revision questions, contexts, datasets, model answers, rubrics and mocks must be independently authored and labelled as Revision-owned AQA-style/aligned practice rather than official AQA material.
Historical or specimen question patterns are calibration evidence, not future-paper invariants unless the current specification explicitly states the rule.
A complete simulated paper must reconcile to 96 attempted marks and 120 minutes, with the exact section and option structure for that paper.
A complete three-paper simulation set must respect current AO weighting ranges and whole-course research-method and mathematical constraints; no single historical paper should be cloned.
Paper 3 option paths must be valid independently: Section A plus one topic from each option group.
Research-method and mathematical demands may appear outside the dedicated Paper 2 Research Methods section and should be represented across preparation assets.
Marking guidance must be Revision-authored from approved AO/assessment facts, the Revision-owned question and permitted Course Truth; protected AQA mark-scheme wording must not be copied.
